description: A message texted to the Assistant is marked "via text". Workspace mode is on. On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. Call "text" texts the message "texted to the Assistant 4f1c" to Shelley through a debug channel, as a phone would. 1. Navigate to /. 2. The header title (h1.header-title) should read exactly "Assistant". 3. Call "text"; it returns "texted". 4. In the element with data-testid "message" whose text contains "texted to the Assistant 4f1c" (within, has_text), the element with data-testid "message-via-text" should read exactly "via text".
